unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 7 - Modelling with Percentages and Money - Year 5-6 Maths.pptx
anchor: read it, model it, solve it, check it: say what the answer means in the situation

lessons.focus: Discounts and sale prices: find the percentage off, then the sale price. Critical feature: the discount is the part taken off; the sale price is what is left. Review: area and perimeter (Week 5).
Best buy: compare unit prices with division and decide which deal is better value. Critical feature: compare the price of the same amount. Review: area and perimeter.
Percentage increases: GST of 10%, price rises and mark-ups. Critical feature: an increase is added on; find the percentage first. Review: four processes.

Multi-step money problems with fractions, decimals and percentages: plan the steps, choose the operations, check the answer makes sense. Critical feature: write a plan before calculating. Review: four processes.

Modelling a shopping problem: formulate it, solve it, interpret the answer and justify choices (a class party on a budget). Critical feature: say what the answer means in the situation. Review: statistics (Week 3).
